$comment: App-store-style privacy manifest for the OASIS Agent Command Center. Generated from the product's real behaviour on 2026-07-27, re-verified 2026-09-28 after the Turso + Cloudflare cutover, and kept in sync with lib/legal/constants.ts (DATA_MATRIX + SUBPROCESSORS), which is what /privacy renders. If you change either, change both in the same commit; tests/legal-compliance-drift.test.ts fails if they disagree.

privacyOfficer.name: Conaugh McKenna
privacyOfficer.title: Person in charge of the protection of personal information
privacyOfficer.titleFr: Responsable de la protection des renseignements personnels

verificationMethod: Static scan of app/, lib/ and components/ for collected form fields, outbound provider hosts, storage, deploy configuration, and analytics SDKs; each processor is pinned to its evidence in tests/legal-compliance-drift.test.ts.

tracking.note: No Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, PostHog, Mixpanel, or @vercel/analytics is present in this application as of the lastVerified date. Cookies are limited to authentication and session state.

security.tenantIsolation: Application-level: customer records carry a tenant_id and application queries filter on the signed-in user's tenant. The database (Turso/libSQL) does not enforce per-customer access rules.
security.applicationLevelEncryption: Stored credentials only (AI provider API keys, email account passwords, OAuth tokens): AES-256-GCM before storage. Other fields, including sensitive identifiers, are not separately encrypted by the application.
security.fileStorage: Private Cloudflare R2 storage (encrypted at rest by Cloudflare), served through short-lived signed links.
security.auditLog: Team membership and access, AI provider settings, automation controls, and e-signature events are written to a per-tenant audit log.

sharedWith: The workspace's model provider (when included in agent context)
The workspace's model provider (when included in agent context)
Anthropic (when present in an uploaded document)
dataCollected.retention: Duration of the active application; deleted on request
dataCollected.regulatoryNote: Sensitive personal information under Quebec Law 25 and the CPRA. Collection requires express consent and, under Law 25 s.3.3, a privacy impact assessment before use in an automated process. Not separately encrypted by the application.

dataCollected.retention: Stored with the application; deleted on request

formerRecipients: Vercel, Inc. (request logs from the period it hosted the application, until September 2026)
dataCollected.retention: Up to 30 days (Cloudflare). Vercel request logs from before September 2026 remain under Vercel's own retention until the Vercel account is closed; see legacyDataLocations.

subprocessors.name: Cloudflare, Inc.
subprocessors.role: Application hosting (Workers), file storage (R2), edge delivery

subprocessors.name: Anthropic PBC
subprocessors.role: LLM inference (Claude); chat, agent tasks, drafting and classification, and document field extraction
subprocessors.openIssue: Some automated tasks run through the Claude Code CLI on an OASIS subscription account, not under a commercial API agreement. Subscription terms differ materially from Anthropic's Commercial Terms and DPA.

subprocessors.name: OpenAI, L.L.C.
subprocessors.role: LLM inference (GPT) when a workspace or agent is configured to use it

subprocessors.name: OpenRouter
subprocessors.role: Model routing when a workspace is configured to use it; forwards to the selected model's host
subprocessors.region: United States; forwarded to the host of the selected model

subprocessors.name: Google LLC
subprocessors.role: Google Workspace APIs (Gmail send and inbox monitoring, Calendar events); Gemini inference when selected

subprocessors.name: Stripe
subprocessors.role: Payments and billing (hosted Checkout; card numbers never reach OASIS servers)

subprocessors.name: Telegram
subprocessors.role: Operational alerts to staff (new-lead, booking, and support alerts)
subprocessors.openIssue: No data processing agreement covers these alerts, which carry lead contact details.

legacyDataLocations.name: Supabase, Inc.
legacyDataLocations.status: Legacy copy of records created before the August 2026 move to Turso. No longer used by the application; planned for deletion.

legacyDataLocations.name: Vercel, Inc.
legacyDataLocations.status: Former application host, until September 2026. No longer receives traffic. Request logs (IP address, request path, timestamp, user agent) and build artifacts from that period remain under Vercel's own retention until the Vercel account is closed.

userRights.optOutOfSale: Not applicable — no sale or sharing as defined by the CPRA

openGaps: No signed DPA covering the LLM providers for the document-extraction path.
No DPA confirmed with Turso (primary database), OpenRouter, Google (Gemini API path), or Telegram.
Law 25 s.17 privacy impact assessment not yet completed for any transfer outside Quebec (including sensitive identifiers); the assessments are in progress while the transfers continue.
Sensitive identifiers (SSN, DOB, EIN) are not encrypted at the application level.
Legacy Supabase copy of pre-August-2026 records not yet deleted.
Vercel request logs and build artifacts from before September 2026 remain with Vercel until the account is closed.
No French-language version of the privacy policy or terms (Charter of the French Language, art. 55, for consumer contracts of adhesion in Quebec).
DMCA Designated Agent not yet registered with the U.S. Copyright Office.
Legal copy has not been reviewed by counsel.
